title: K-flat resolutions survive the coefficient-universe lift
statement: For any commutative ring B in universe t and any unbounded cochain complex P of B-modules in universe t, there exist a complex R and a quasi-isomorphism f:R→P such that R is K-flat and its degreewise universe lift, restricted along ULift B ≃ B, is K-flat as a complex of modules over ULift B in universe t+1. K-flat means preservation of all quasi-isomorphisms by total tensor on either side [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso]. No bound, finite generation, or flatness hypothesis on P is required.

source.place: lemma-K-flat-resolution (Tag 06Y4), combined with the flat-term K-flat preservation argument of sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-pullback-K-flat (Tag 0G7E).

proof.text: Choose the existing flat-term K-flat resolution R→P in the small module universe. The free-on-underlying-set construction supplies functorial flat resolutions there.

The coefficient lift preserves flat modules: first lift the module carrier, then use flatness invariance under ULift of the ring. It preserves integer-indexed colimits: the small module forgetful functor preserves filtered colimits, the type-universe lift preserves colimits, and the larger module forgetful functor reflects filtered colimits. The forgetful functors use their size-shrunk filtered-colimit instances.

Apply kFlat_map_of_flat_terms to the chosen small flat-term K-flat resolution. This proves K-flatness of its image against every large-universe acyclic complex, not only lifted small tests. The categorical and total-tensor K-flat predicates agree definitionally.

proof_origin.place: lemma-K-flat-resolution, using the existing flat-term K-flat preservation theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem CochainComplex.exists_coefficientLift_kFlat_resolution
    {B : Type t} [CommRing B] (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ) :
    ∃ (R : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{t} B) ℤ) (f : R ⟶ P),
      QuasiIso f ∧ R.IsKFlatForTotalTensor ∧
        CochainComplex.IsKFlatForTotalTensor
        (((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
          ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
            (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj R)
